rationale: The pain is real — HR managers face genuine confusion when retaining internationally relocating employees via EOR — but it is structurally low-frequency (one trigger per relocation event per company), and a single forum post does not meet the minimum 5 distinct pain quotes required for a pass verdict. Willingness-to-pay is indirect: buyers are already spending on EOR contracts ($500–$1,500/employee/month) but no signal exists of someone paying for pre-sales advisory guidance specifically. The narrow trigger frequency undermines recurring revenue potential and the evidence base is insufficient to advance.
